name: libero_soup_to_basket
description: Place the alphabet soup can into the basket with the body's libero_pick_place skill: predicts a fresh receipt, runs it, polls the same job to a terminal state, and returns only when state=succeeded, goalStatus=achieved and stopStatus=confirmed.
requires: A LIBERO Panda body whose skills include libero_pick_place; the soup can and basket are perceived in ego_state and their ids are passed as args.target and args.on.
ensures: The can rests in the basket (grasp and placement confirmed by the skill's evidence) and the returned object reports state=succeeded, goalStatus=achieved, stopStatus=confirmed; otherwise throws an Error carrying the job status instead of retrying.

parameters.target: ES reference of the alphabet soup can to pick (for example e:1:can)
parameters.on: ES reference of the basket to place it in (for example e:1:basket)
